introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched forward. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return. 

It primarily works the rectus abdominis muscle and the obliques.
name: ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
You will get better results if you do it slowly.
Relax your neck.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
It's not right to use your arms to propel your body upwards.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when raising, and inhale when lowering.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
You shouldn't feel your neck is sore.
It's a good workout for your abs.

introduce:
Lie on the floor with your toes and forearms on the ground. Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens the abdomen, back and shoulders.
name: PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Breathe naturally.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your lower back.
Too hard? Lower your knees on the mat with your ankles crossed in the air.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
It's not right if your shoulders or lower back are sore.
This exercise works your core.
This exercise is good for your spine.

introduce: Lie on the ground with your legs bent and your arms by your sides. \n\nSlightly lift your upper body off the floor and make your hands alternately reach your heels.
name: HEEL TOUCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in a natural position.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Engage your core.
Exhale when touching your heels and inhale when going back.
It's a great exercise for all of your abdominal muscles.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bring your knee to your opposite elbow. \n\nReturn to the start position and repeat with the other side.
name: STANDING BICYCLE CRUNCHES

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
You can feel your entire core squeezing.
Exhale when lift your knees and inhale when lower them.
This exercise works on your entire core.
